name: The third and fourth tablets

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

summary: From the scarlet fields of the Eastern Plaguelands, the search climbs to the old troll ziggurat. Two tablets are found among its stones, bringing Ironboot another pair. The seeker carries the record deeper into the plague-scarred north, where the ziggurat adds its fragment to the tale.
